High-profile presence of BSC at the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis

Nov. 13, 2026 — The Barcelona Supercomputing Center – Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) returns to SC, the world’s leading conference on high-performance computing, networking, storage and analysis. Over six days, BSC researchers will lead a tutorial, organize and chair workshops, present papers and posters, and run Birds of a Feather sessions. The BSC booth is #4259.

Their work covers programming models, SmartNICs and accelerators, scientific workflows, AI and large language models for science, climate and Earth sciences, memory systems, quantum computing and RISC-V. Most sessions will be livestreamed.
